# Problem 1

```{r}
data("penguins", package = "palmerpenguins")
```

The `penguins` dataset contains variables including `r paste(names(penguins), collapse = ", ")`. One important categorical variable is `species`, which contains the values `r paste(unique(na.omit(penguins$species)), collapse = ", ")`.
The species variable contains the values `r unique(na.omit(penguins$species))`.



The `penguins` dataset contains measurements of individual penguins. The measurements include variables of  `r colnames(penguins)`.
 contains `r nrow(penguins)` rows and `r ncol(penguins)` columns.
